title: Forms
admin_description: Build questionnaires, publish a shareable link, and review responses.
empty: No forms yet. Create your first questionnaire.
closed: This form is closed. Responses can no longer be submitted or edited.
slug_help: Used in /forms/name. Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only.
slug_locked_help: The URL stays fixed after first publication so shared links keep working.
account_access: Signed-in users with a verified email

policies.single_editable: One response, editable until the form closes
policies.single: One response, no editing after submission

guest_limit_help: Guests are recognized by a browser cookie. Limits are per browser, not per person. Submissions are also rate-limited by IP.
preview_notice: Preview only. Answers entered here will not be submitted.
translation_help: English is required. Other languages are optional and fall back to English.
thank_you: Thank you for sharing your feedback.
publish_help: Save before publishing. Published question versions are preserved so older responses retain their original meaning.

confirm.publish: Publish the saved form at its public URL? New forms begin accepting responses immediately.
confirm.unpublish: Hide the public form? Existing responses will be kept.
confirm.close: Stop new responses and edits? The form will remain visible.
confirm.open: Allow responses again using the currently published questions?

identity_notice: Your response is linked to your account and is visible to FullParty administrators.
guest_notice: Responses are visible to FullParty administrators. Guest responses are recognized using a cookie in this browser.
sign_in_required: Sign in with a verified email address to respond.
already_submitted: You have already submitted a response to this form.
editable_notice: You can edit your response until this form closes.
version_changed: The questions have changed since your last response. Check your answers before saving again.
results_description: Review summaries and individual responses, or export a CSV for analysis.
version_results_help: Responses for this question version: {count}. Responses edited for a newer version appear under that version.
text_results_help: Open an individual response below to read the answers.
no_responses: No responses for this version yet.
load_failed: Could not load this response. Please try again.

errors.options: Choice questions need at least two options.
errors.range: The maximum must be greater than or equal to the minimum.
errors.changed: This form has changed. Reload the page before submitting.
errors.response_changed: Your response was updated in another tab. Reload before editing again.
errors.conflict: Another admin updated this form. Reload before saving.
errors.slug_locked: The URL cannot be changed after publication.
